review_title: Percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy versus nasogastric tube feeding for adults with swallowing disturbances
screening_criteria: We planned to include randomised controlled trials comparing PEG versus NGT for adults with swallowing disturbances or dysphagia and indications for nutritional support, with any underlying diseases.
